stories.headline: Seattle Art Fair's Tenth Edition Opens Tonight at Lumen Field
stories.body: The Seattle Art Fair returns for its milestone tenth edition, July 23–26 at Lumen Field Event Center, featuring 95 galleries from 13 countries and four continents. This year's fair spotlights textile and fiber art, with first-time exhibitors including STUDIO DRIFT and a special presentation of contemporary Ukrainian art. Opening Night (VIP/Fair Pass holders) kicks off tonight at 6pm; public hours run Friday–Sunday, 11am–7pm, with kids 12 and under free.
stories.location: SoDo · Thu July 23 (VIP 6–9pm) through Sun July 26

stories.headline: 300 Vendors, 54 Bands: Bite of Seattle Is Back This Weekend
stories.body: The beloved Bite of Seattle takes over Seattle Center July 24–26 (11am–8pm daily) with 300 food and retail vendors, cooking demos, wine and beer gardens, and 54 live bands. Friday is your best bet if you hate crowds — scoop up plates before the weekend rush. It's one of Seattle's biggest annual food festivals and a full sensory overload in the best possible way.

stories.headline: Maren Morris Serenades the Animals at ZooTunes Tonight
stories.body: Woodland Park Zoo's beloved BECU ZooTunes summer concert series — now in its 42nd season — welcomes country superstar Maren Morris to the idyllic North Meadow stage tonight at 4:30pm. Spread a blanket, bring a low-backed chair, and if you're 21+, spring for the "zoocuterie" board with sparkling wine and branded tumblers you get to take home. The series runs June through August, raising funds for animal care and wildlife conservation.

stories.headline: Hell's Kitchen Brings Alicia Keys' Fire to the Paramount Through August
stories.body: The Tony Award-winning Broadway hit Hell's Kitchen, written by Alicia Keys, tells the coming-of-age story of a 17-year-old girl searching for freedom and her place in the world — all set to Keys' iconic songbook. The show runs at The Paramount Theatre July 22–August 16, with multiple showtimes weekly. Tickets start around $58, and yes, you will absolutely belt along in your seat.

stories.headline: Free Shakespeare in the Park: Wooden O's Macbeth Runs All Summer
stories.body: Wooden O's free outdoor production of Shakespeare's Macbeth is performing in parks throughout the Puget Sound area now through August 28. Pack a blanket, a chair, and a picnic — no tickets required, just show up and let the Bard do the work. Check the schedule online for specific park locations and dates nearest you.
stories.location: Parks across Puget Sound · Through Aug 28, 7:30pm

stories.headline: Cheer On the Storm: Seattle's WNBA Stars Play at Climate Pledge All Summer
stories.body: The Seattle Storm are in full swing at Climate Pledge Arena, with home games running through September 27. Catch world-class women's basketball in one of the loudest, most electric arenas in the city — the Storm have always delivered must-see summer nights. Check the schedule for upcoming home matchups and grab tickets before they sell out.
stories.location: Seattle Center · Through Sept 27, times vary
